prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production diffuse/base-color ground texture for a Unity 3D game, full-bleed horizontal panorama approximately 3:1.
Transform the supplied reference into a clean MATERIAL ALBEDO SHEET: remove every raised ridge, rock, boulder, wall, ruin, creature, object, vegetation clump, pipe, vent, tar seep, shadow and highlight caused by 3D lighting, and fill their areas with continuous flat fossil-woodstone ground. Preserve the reference ground's hand-sculpted Living Woodcut style: dusty pink-grey stone with warm salmon and pale sandstone layers, fine broken branching fibres and broad irregular worn grain that predominantly travels east-west, occasional subtle elongated fossil knots, desaturated ochre mineral stains. Grain should have several scales and natural irregular breaks and forks; avoid perfectly periodic parallel sine-wave lines. Quiet traversable visual texture, richness from colored mineral structure rather than dark cracks or surface objects. Entire image is the same flat material plane viewed straight down, equally sharp everywhere. Diffuse pigment only, neutral even unlit illumination: no baked shadows, no directional sunlight, no ambient occlusion, no 3D depth shading, no specular gleam, no black pits. No obvious tile grid, no borders, no labels, no text, no watermarks, no transparency. This is material for separately modeled geometry, not a screenshot or a complete game scene.
review: Full-bleed opaque mineral material; no raised props, creatures, tar, pipes, or baked cast shadows. Fine directional pigment contrast remains artistic albedo, not native geometry.
